 Follow VAVEL on Google 11:30 AM ET 3 hours ago Thanks!
 And that's all for now! Thank you so much for watching this Saudi Pro League match, with all the action and excitement here on VAVEL! Stay tuned for updates and upcoming games. Good afternoon and see you next time!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 11:28 AM ET 3 hours ago END OF MATCH
 Al-Hamdan opened the scoring for Al-Nassr in the first half, with Cristiano Ronaldo adding at the beginning of the second half. Bongonda discounted the score, with Ângelo closing the score at 3-1 for Al-Nassr's victory!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 90' 11:23 AM ET 3 hours ago AT THE BAR
 Mendy received Barnawi's cross in the box and headed hard, but into the hands of Bento. Soon after, Mendy had another chance at the cross and headed hard, hitting the crossbar! And we will have four more minutes of extra time in the game!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 85' 11:20 AM ET 3 hours ago Changes in both teams
 We have substitutions on both sides for today's game! On the Al-Faisaly side, Almogren and Al-Shanqiti are replaced by Al-Shereaf and Al-Safri. On the Al-Nassr side, Al-Hamdan, Al-Khaibari and Mané are replaced by Alnajdi, Al-Naji and Haqawi.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 80' 11:17 AM ET 3 hours ago GOAL FOR AL-NASSR
 Al Hamdan found the pass up front for Angelo, who burst into the area and shot powerfully into the right corner, sending the ball into the back of the net, making it 3-1 for Al-Nassr, who are now two goals ahead once again!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 75' 11:13 AM ET 3 hours ago Pacheco
 Shanqiti received the pass up front and crossed for Subayt to head powerfully, but wide. Shortly after, Cristiano Ronaldo had a chance from Yahya's cross, heading powerfully, but into Pacheco's hands, who saved Al-Faisaly!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 70' 11:10 AM ET 4 hours ago Changes in Al-Nassr
 Al-Nassr made a substitution, bringing on Angelo for Samú Costa. Shortly after, Mendy received a pass from Al Mogren up front and took a powerful shot, which was blocked by the defense once again. Al-Faisaly is trying to equalize!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 65' 11:07 AM ET 4 hours ago GOAL FOR AL-FAISALY
 On the counter-attack, Al-Faisaly reduces the deficit! Al-Shanqiti received the pass up front and crossed the ball into the area for Théo Bongonda to head powerfully into the left corner, sending the ball into the back of the net and reducing the score for the home team!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 60' 11:04 AM ET 4 hours ago Changes in Al Faisaly
 Iñigo Martínez, after a cross from João Félix, managed a powerful header, but it went wide. Shortly after, Al-Faisaly made three substitutions, with Al Bishi, Al Muwallad, and Jahfali leaving the field and Bin Subayt, Jaime Seoane, and Bongonda entering.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 55' 11:02 AM ET 4 hours ago GOAL DISALLOWED
 Al-Hamdan had received the pass up front to find Cristiano in the box, who shot into the back of the net for his second goal of the game! BUT, after a VAR review, the goal was disallowed for offside at the start of the play, leaving the score at 2-0!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 50' 10:59 AM ET 4 hours ago GOAL FOR AL-NASSR
 Cristiano Ronaldo, on a cross from João Félix, rose higher than the defense to head the ball powerfully into the back of the net, extending Al-Nassr's lead early in the second half! 18 more to go until their 1000th goal!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 10:55 AM ET 4 hours ago SECOND HALF STARTS
 The players returned to the field and the ball rolled for the second half of the match between Al-Faisaly and Al-Nassr, in the eleventh round of the Saudi Pro League, with all the action and excitement of the match in real time here on VAVEL!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 10:28 AM ET 4 hours ago END OF FIRST HALF
 And we're heading into halftime in a balanced game, where Al-Nassr started by creating chances to take the lead with a goal from Al-Hamdan. After the goal, Al-Faisaly managed to balance the game and finished the match with high pressure, but without managing to equalize!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 45' 10:25 AM ET 4 hours ago Out again
 Barnawi received the pass up front and managed a long-range shot, but sent the ball wide to the right of the goal! Al-Faisaly is creating dangerous chances in this final stretch of the first half, piling up opportunities!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 40' 10:22 AM ET 4 hours ago Out
 Abdulaziz Al Bishi received Barnawi's pass up front and shot from distance, which deflected out for a corner kick, which was cleared by the defense. And, under pressure, Mendy had a chance with a long-range shot, but again sent the ball wide.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 35' 10:15 AM ET 4 hours ago AT THE BAR
 João Félix made a through pass to Cristiano Ronaldo, who shot powerfully as he entered the area, hitting the crossbar! Shortly after, Andrei Girotto received the pass and shot from distance, but it was blocked by the defense. He then got the rebound and shot hard, but wide.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 30' 10:07 AM ET 5 hours ago Blocked
 Al-Faisaly won a corner, which was taken into the box but cleared by the defense. The next play resulted in a cross into the area, where Andrei Girotto headed the ball on for Mendy to get a powerful shot off, but it was blocked by the defense once again.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 25' 10:03 AM ET 5 hours ago Yellow card
 Samú Costa received a yellow card for a hard foul on Barnawi. Shortly after, the game was paused for the players to hydrate due to the intense heat, with play resuming shortly thereafter in the Majmaah Sports City.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 20' 9:57 AM ET 5 hours ago Al-Nassr dominates
 Al-Nassr now controls the pace and does not speed up the game. Winning the match 1-0, Al-Nassr tries to control what happens on the field at that moment, while Al-Faisaly tries to attack, but without being able to finish once again.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 15' 9:54 AM ET 5 hours ago Yellow card
 Awad Aman received a yellow card for a foul that turned into an advantage after an offside attack by the home team. And João Félix, on a pass from Mané, managed a powerful shot, but it was blocked by the defense once again.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 9:52 AM ET 5 hours ago Out
 Al-Faisaly responded quickly, with Mendy receiving the pass and shooting powerfully as he entered the area, but sending the ball wide. Al-Nassr managed to dominate the game in this early stage, but saw Al-Faisaly respond with a good finish.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5' 9:51 AM ET 5 hours ago GOAL FOR AL-NASSR
 The game has barely started and Al-Nassr is ahead on the scoreboard! Mané received the pass in front and found Al-Hamdan, who hit hard from distance, sending the ball into the left corner, low, to open the scoring for Al-Nassr away from home!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 9:33 AM ET 5 hours ago HERE WE GO
 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Al-Faisaly vs. Al-Nassr clash, in the first 45 minutes of this 11th round Saudi Pro League match, with all the action and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 9:32 AM ET 5 hours ago Al-Nassr's bench
 For the game, Ange Postecoglou will have the following names available during the match against Al-Faisaly: Abdulhadi Al-Alwan, Saad Al-Nasser, Salem Alnajdi, Majed Mohammed, Ayman Yahya, Ângelo, Sami Al-NAji, Haydar Abdulkareem and Saad Haqawi.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 9:31 AM ET 5 hours ago Al-Faisaly's bench
 For the game, Giovanni Solinas will have the following names available during the match against Al-Nassr: Mohammed Al-Hasawi, Abdullah Bin Subayt, Saud Haddad, Jaime Seonae, André Jordy Ella, Théo Bongonda, Abdulrahman Al-Shereaf and Faisal Al-Fahad.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 9:28 AM ET 5 hours ago Al-Nassr lined-up!
 With a 4-4-2 formation, Al-Nassr's starting lineup for the Saudi Pro League match against Al-Faisaly is: Bento, Boushal, Al-Amri, Iñigo Martínez and Aman; João Félix, Samu Costa, Al-Khaibari and Mané; Al-Hamdan and Cristiano Ronaldo.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 9:26 AM ET 5 hours ago Al-Faisaly lined-up!
 With a 4-3-3 formation, Al-Faisaly's starting lineup for the Saudi Pro League match against Al-Nassr is: Pacheco, Andrei Girotto, Seck and Jahfali; Barnawi, Flávio, Muwallad and Al-Shanqiti; Al Bishi, Mendy and Almogren.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 9:18 AM ET 5 hours ago Good morning!
 We're starting the broadcast of the match, with all the action and excitement of the duel between Al-Faisaly and Al-Nassr, in this 11th round of the Saudi Pro League, with the ball rolling at Majmaah Sports City Stadium, in this game between two teams from opposite ends of the table!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
